## 5-Day Seoul Grocery Meal Plan for 3
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

Designed for a **KRW 120,000 weekly budget**, with **weekday meals under 30 minutes**, and adjusted for **one vegetarian** plus **one dairy-free** eater. I’m assuming you want **dinners for 5 weekdays** and that pantry basics like salt, pepper, soy sauce, and cooking oil are already on hand.

## Ranked 5-Day Plan and Shopping List
| Day | Meal | Time | Est. cost per meal | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Tofu bibimbap bowls | 20 min | KRW 16,000 | Vegetarian + dairy-free; use eggs only as optional topping |
| 2 | Kimchi tofu stir-fry with rice | 20 min | KRW 15,000 | Add chicken on the side for non-vegetarian portions if wanted |
| 3 | Soy-garlic chicken lettuce wraps | 25 min | KRW 18,000 | Easy split meal: chicken for two, tofu/beans for vegetarian |
| 4 | Japchae-style glass noodle veggie skillet | 25 min | KRW 17,000 | Add egg strips or tofu; naturally dairy-free |
| 5 | Quick miso-style soup bowls with rice and pan-fried tofu | 20 min | KRW 14,000 | Light finish to stay within budget |

### Day-by-Day Meal Cards

**Day 1: Tofu Bibimbap Bowls**
- **Main:** rice, spinach, bean sprouts, carrot, cucumber, tofu, sesame oil, gochujang on the side
- **Fast prep:** blanch vegetables while rice cooks; pan-sear tofu cubes
- **Dairy-free:** yes
- **Vegetarian:** yes
- **Substitution:** if gochujang is too spicy, use soy sauce + sesame oil + a little sugar

**Day 2: Kimchi Tofu Stir-Fry with Rice**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/fire.svg
- **Main:** kimchi, tofu, onion, cabbage, rice
- **Fast prep:** stir-fry kimchi and onion first, then add tofu and cabbage
- **Dairy-free:** yes
- **Vegetarian:** yes
- **Substitution:** if kimchi is not vegetarian, buy “vegan kimchi” or use napa cabbage + chili flakes + vinegar

**Day 3: Soy-Garlic Chicken Lettuce Wraps**
- **Main:** chicken, lettuce, cucumber, carrot, garlic, soy sauce, rice
- **Fast prep:** cook chicken in a quick soy-garlic glaze; serve with lettuce and rice
- **Dairy-free:** yes
- **Vegetarian swap:** tofu or tempeh in the same glaze
- **Substitution:** if lettuce is expensive, use cabbage leaves or perilla leaves

**Day 4: Japchae-Style Glass Noodle Veggie Skillet**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- **Main:** glass noodles, onion, carrot, spinach, mushrooms, tofu or egg
- **Fast prep:** soak noodles, then toss everything in one pan
- **Dairy-free:** yes
- **Vegetarian:** yes
- **Substitution:** if sweet potato noodles are pricey, use thin wheat noodles or rice noodles

**Day 5: Quick Miso-Style Soup Bowls with Rice and Pan-Fried Tofu**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Main:** tofu, mushrooms, zucchini, onion, seaweed, rice
- **Fast prep:** simmer vegetables, add tofu, serve with rice
- **Dairy-free:** yes
- **Vegetarian:** yes
- **Substitution:** if miso paste is hard to find, use doenjang in small amounts for a Korean-style version

## Consolidated Shopping List
| Item | Quantity for 5 days / 3 people | Est. cost | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Rice | 3–4 kg | KRW 12,000 | Core staple for every meal |
| Firm tofu | 8–10 blocks | KRW 15,000 | Main protein for vegetarian/dairy-free meals |
| Eggs | 10–15 | KRW 5,000 | Optional protein and topping |
| Chicken breast or thigh | 700 g–1 kg | KRW 12,000 | For one mixed-protein meal |
| Kimchi | 1 large tub | KRW 6,000 | Check ingredients if vegetarian is strict |
| Spinach | 2 bunches | KRW 4,000 | Bibimbap and noodle skillet |
| Bean sprouts | 2 packs | KRW 3,000 | Cheap and fast for bibimbap |
| Carrots | 4–5 | KRW 3,000 | Salads, stir-fries, wraps |
| Cucumber | 3–4 | KRW 4,000 | Fresh side and wraps |
| Onion | 6–8 | KRW 4,000 | Base for most dishes |
| Cabbage or napa cabbage | 1 head | KRW 4,000 | Flexible bulk vegetable |
| Mushrooms | 2 packs | KRW 5,000 | Soup and noodle skillet |
| Lettuce or perilla leaves | 2 heads / 1 pack | KRW 6,000 | Wrap night |
| Glass noodles | 2 packs | KRW 5,000 | Japchae-style meal |
| Seaweed / dried kelp | 1 pack | KRW 3,000 | Soup base and flavor |
| Garlic | 1 bulb pack | KRW 2,000 | Essential flavoring |
| Soy sauce | 1 bottle | KRW 4,000 | If not already stocked |
| Sesame oil | 1 small bottle | KRW 5,000 | Bibimbap and finishing flavor |
| Gochujang or doenjang | 1 tub | KRW 4,000 | Korean seasoning base |
| Fruit or snack add-on | 2–3 items | KRW 10,000 | Apples, bananas, or yogurt alternative |

**Estimated weekly total:** **KRW 109,000–118,000**
This leaves a small cushion for price swings, extra vegetables, or a dairy-free snack.

## Ingredient Swaps for Seoul Grocery Stores
- **Hard-to-find vegan kimchi:** use regular kimchi only if it fits your vegetarian rule; otherwise choose **vegan kimchi** or replace with **napa cabbage + chili + vinegar + garlic**.
- **Miso paste:** swap with **doenjang** for a Korean-style soup base.
- **Tempeh:** if unavailable, use **tofu, edamame, or chickpeas**.
- **Sweet potato noodles:** use **rice noodles** or **thin wheat noodles** if cheaper or easier to find.
- **Perilla leaves:** use **lettuce, cabbage leaves, or spinach wraps**.
- **Dairy-free sauce needs:** avoid creamy dressings; use **soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, and garlic**.
